canonical_title: JustOne: A Mobile Application for Posting Advertisements to Multiple Social Media Platforms
abstract: Online sellers who advertise on social media must repost the same advertisement on each platform one by one, which divides their time and effort. The team designed JustOne, a mobile application for iOS that shares one advertisement post to Instagram, Facebook and Line at once. The report cites market research that 44 percent of local businesses in Thailand depend on promoting their businesses on social media. The app is planned as a free download on the Apple App Store with banner ads for free users. Premium features add customer chat via Line and a point of sale system with order history and printable shipment labels.

abstract: The manual senior project procedure at the faculty causes duplicated group lists, weak matching between students and advisors, and heavy paperwork. The team built a website, the VMS Senior Project System, where science and technology students form groups, select up to five topics and set priorities. Lecturers post and manage topics, rank student groups, set committees, download submitted documents and score projects. An administrator runs a matching algorithm that assigns topics, sets deadlines, maintains a repository of past reports and sends email notifications. The system was developed with PHP, HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript, uses MySQL on Apache with XAMPP, and verifies users through the university LDAP Active Directory.

abstract: This project is aimed at developing a scheduler for group meetings. This is a webbased tool. Any managers can call for a meeting and send the details co-ordinates of the meeting (location, date, time etc.) to all invitees. This is useful for a small office, school or a department. Facility to book room and editing meeting points are also available. Room reservation system can be a very helpful system within companies or organizations. It provides services such as reserving a room for a meeting or conference within a few minutes and can also remind the participants about the meeting or conference. Furthermore, it can also reply back to the organizer who will be available or on that day or who will not be able to attend to the meeting.

abstract: Today, the restaurant business has been growing rapidly. Every restaurant tries to present something new and unique to its customers. Many successful restaurants attract customers, but many of them fail. A contributing factor in addition to food, the more important is the service that is offered. The system integrates restaurant management, or simply called restaurant management system, will greatly helping restaurants to provide faster and better service to its customers, at the same time providing reliable control for the management of the restaurant. that's why we want to try to apply an online-based system to facilitate transactions and provide convenience for customers. Restaurant management system can handle the overall operations of the restaurant, from the moment customers arrive, order a meal, food preparation, up until customers make a payment and left the restaurant.

abstract: Biddingpluz is the web-based online application in which provide the auction service to both seller and buyer. Users are able to place bid or post the item they want. The concentration of our project is the bidding logic inside the system. For instance, the bidding price increment and Buy it now logic are examples of the critical parts we are interested to study. It is not only the general function but also the auction function we intend to focus on the system to work properly.
